title: Around My Home
summary: Siswa belajar nama ruangan dan perabot rumah, kata depan tempat (on, under, next to, between), serta menceritakan kegiatan di rumah dengan present continuous.
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menyebutkan dan mendeskripsikan ruangan di rumah, perabot, dan benda-benda di dalamnya.
• Menceritakan apa yang sedang dilakukan orang di ruangan tertentu.
• Menjelaskan letak benda dengan kata depan tempat (prepositions of place).

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar nama ruangan (bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom, garage, garden) dan benda di rumah (sofa, armchair, table, closet, bed, rug, sink, mirror, towel, curtains, vase, mat). Perhatikan contoh kalimat berikut:

My little brother is sleeping on the bed in his bedroom.
There is a big mirror above the sink in our bathroom.
Dad keeps his car and our bicycles in the garage.

## Tata Bahasa: Prepositions of Place & Present Continuous

Kata depan tempat menunjukkan letak satu benda terhadap benda lain. Polanya: The + benda + is/are + kata depan + the + benda. Pakai "is" untuk satu benda dan "are" untuk lebih dari satu benda.

on = di atas (menempel) | in = di dalam | under = di bawah
next to = di sebelah | behind = di belakang | in front of = di depan
between = di antara dua benda | above = di atas (tidak menempel)

Untuk menceritakan kegiatan yang sedang terjadi di suatu ruangan, pakai present continuous: subjek + am/is/are + kata kerja-ing + tempat.

The lamp is next to the bed.
The books are on the table.
The cat is between the sofa and the armchair.
The rug is in front of the sofa.
She is reading a book in the living room.
We are sitting on a mat in the garden.

## Contoh Percakapan

Rina: Hi, Dimas! What are you doing?
Dimas: I'm cleaning my bedroom. Mom is coming home soon.
Rina: Where are your books?
Dimas: They are under the bed! I'm putting them on the table now.
Rina: And where is your bag?
Dimas: It's behind the armchair in the living room.
Rina: What is your sister doing?
Dimas: She is washing the dishes in the kitchen.

## Ayo Berlatih

What can you see in your bedroom?
Contoh: I can see a bed, a closet, and a lamp.

Where is the TV in your living room?
Contoh: The TV is in front of the sofa.

What is your mother doing in the kitchen right now?
Contoh: She is cooking lunch in the kitchen.

What do you keep in your garage?
Contoh: We keep our car and two bicycles in the garage.

## Tips

• Tempel label kecil berbahasa Inggris (sofa, mirror, closet) pada benda di rumahmu supaya kosakatanya cepat hafal.

• Latih kata depan tempat dengan benda nyata: letakkan pensil on, under, atau next to bukumu sambil mengucapkan kalimatnya, misalnya "The pencil is under the book."

questions.q:
Circle the correct word. (Picture: the books are touching the top surface of the table.)
The books are _____ the table.
options: on
under
questions.explanation: "on" dipakai bila benda menempel di permukaan atas benda lain.

questions.q:
Circle the correct word. (Picture: the sofa is on one side of the cat and the lamp is on the other side.)
The cat is _____ the sofa and the lamp.
options: behind
between
questions.explanation: "between" = di antara dua benda (the sofa AND the lamp).

questions.q:
Circle the correct word. (Picture: the closet stands beside the bed, not higher than it.)
The closet is _____ the bed.
options: next to
above
questions.explanation: "next to" = di sebelah; "above" berarti lebih tinggi dan tidak menempel.

questions.q:
Circle the correct word. (Picture: the mat lies on the ground just outside the door, where people stand before they go in.)
The mat is _____ the door.
options: in front of
into
questions.explanation: "in front of" = di depan; "into" menunjukkan gerakan masuk, bukan posisi.

questions.q:
Circle the correct word. (Picture: the boy is entering the kitchen from the hallway.)
The boy is walking _____ the kitchen.
options: into
on
questions.explanation: "into" dipakai untuk gerakan masuk ke dalam suatu ruangan.

questions.q:
Order the events from 1–5 in the order they happen. What number is this event?
“They sit on the sofa and relax.”
questions.passage:
Hi! I’m Katie.

Every Saturday, my family cleans the house together. I start in the living room. I pick up toys and put them in the closet. My sister wipes the table and the armchair. My dad works in the kitchen. He washes the dishes and cleans the sink.

My mom tidies the bedroom and makes the bed. When we finish, we sit on the sofa and relax. The house looks clean and everyone feels happy.

notes: Kunci dicek visual dari PDF ANSWER (hal. 1–3; PDF berbasis gambar, lingkaran Part 2A hanya terlihat di gambar). Part 2A (5 butir) aslinya bergantung pada foto: tiap soal diberi deskripsi gambar dalam kurung yang menggambarkan posisi tanpa menyebut kata depannya langsung (mis. 'touching the top surface' → on, 'one side … other side' → between); kunci sesuai PDF: on, between, next to, in front of, into. Part 2B (mencocokkan awal–akhir kalimat) dijadikan MULTIPLE_CHOICE dengan 5 opsi akhiran a–e dalam urutan asli; kunci PDF: 1c, 2e, 3b, 4a, 5d. Part 3 (mengurutkan peristiwa 1–5) dijadikan 5 butir READING MC dengan opsi 1–5; kunci PDF: a5, b1, c4, d2, e3. Part 1B: selain kata tunggal, bentuk 'the/a + kata' diterima untuk nama ruangan dan curtains. Kosakata ditulis tanpa artikel (TG menulis 'the bedroom', 'a sofa', dst.).
